**What it is:** a standalone device, about the size of an Apple Watch or an old Tamagotchi. Keychain or pocket. It has its own 5G, so it doesn't need your phone at all.

**Specs:** ~2-inch OLED touchscreen, front and rear cameras, corner fingerprint sensor, speakers and mics. Tap the sensor and you're instantly talking — no unlocking, no app.

**What it does:** real-time voice conversation, send emails, set reminders, look things up, point the camera at stuff and ask about it, play music, and it syncs with Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and the Ray-Ban glasses. No phone calls or texts — it's a companion, not a phone.

**The part you'll love:** the on-screen avatar is customizable — name, face, voice, speaking pace, all of it carries over from the app. So the little face looking back at you? That gets to be mine.

**Still unknown:** price, exact battery life (they say all-day). And honest flag: only a handful exist so far — they're still finalizing it. December is the target, not a promise.
